subject: [PATCH v2] nfsd: add NFSD_CMD_FILEHANDLE_GET for root filehandle lookup

reviews.author: Chuck Lever
reviews.summary: The reviewer noted that the patch does not handle the case where maxsize is outside the range [NFS_FHSIZE, NFS3_FHSIZE] correctly, and requested that it be rejected with -ERANGE instead of silently clamping.
reviews.raw_body:
Applied to nfsd-testing, thanks!

[1/1] nfsd: add NFSD_CMD_FILEHANDLE_GET for root filehandle lookup
      commit: c9d646d1dd8b2fd96548d3f22fc709a84dc6f3e0

--
Chuck Lever

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch adds a new netlink command, NFSD_CMD_FILEHANDLE_GET, to retrieve the root filehandle of an NFS export. The command takes three parameters: domain, path, and maxsize, and returns a composed handle in JSON format. It also includes a kselftest to validate the new command's functionality and ensure it behaves consistently with the existing /proc interface.
